title: Short exact complex presentation on an arbitrary open union
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose derived category of module sheaves and the derived categories on all localized open sites exist in a common Hom universe [def-pc-derived-category]. For every open $T$, write $R_T=D(\operatorname{overFunctor}_T)$, and fix a functor $G_T$ and an adjunction $a_T:R_T\dashv G_T$. Let $U,V$ be arbitrary opens and $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$. Set $A=G_{U\cup V}R_{U\cup V}(E)$, $B=G_UR_U(E)\oplus G_VR_V(E)$, and $C=G_{U\cap V}R_{U\cap V}(E)$. Let $\beta:R_{U\cup V}A\to R_{U\cup V}E$ be the transpose of $1_A$, and let $b:A\to B$ be the biproduct lift of the $a_U$ and $a_V$ transposes of the two canonical restrictions of $\beta$ [lem-sc-derived-hom-mayer-vietoris]. There is a short complex $S$ of cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and isomorphisms $e_A:Q(S.X_1)\xrightarrow\sim A$, $e_B:Q(S.X_2)\xrightarrow\sim B$, $e_C:Q(S.X_3)\xrightarrow\sim C$, such that $S$ is short exact and $Q(S.f)\,;\,e_B=e_A\,;\,b$, where the semicolon denotes composition in order of application. No connecting map, integer shift or distinguishedness is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08BV, lemma-exact-sequence-j-star, displayed short exact sequence of complexes in the proof, applied on U union V and viewed by ordinary direct image on X; Tag 079W, lemma-adjoint

proof.text: Use the Grothendieck property from [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Take the actual source-library kInjectiveResolutionFunctor of a Mathlib Q preimage of E, with its constructed quasi-isomorphism and termwise injectivity. Q inverts the quasi-isomorphism, giving Q(I) isomorphic to E.

Apply [lem-pc-open-union-image-complex-exact] to the constructed I. Take S to be ShortComplex.mk of the fixed lift of union restrictions and fixed difference to the overlap, using the supplied zero-composition proof; its short exactness is part of this lemma.

Obtain the open-image comparisons and their nested restriction identities from [lem-pc-localized-open-image-complex-comparisons]. Set eA=e_(U union V), eC=e_(U intersection V), and construct eB from Q.mapBiprod followed by biprod.mapIso eU eV. The identity biprod.map_lift_mapBiprod computes Q(f). Check both projections with biprod.hom_ext; each projection is exactly the nested restriction identity. This proves the original presentation including its first-arrow equation.

proof_origin.note: Adapted from Stacks Tags 08BV, 08BS and 079W; tag pages read directly because the local literature checkout contains only citation indexes.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits for MayerVietorisSquare, its additive-group sheaf shortComplex, shortComplex_exact, shortComplex_shortExact and Opens.mayerVietorisSquare. None supplies the K-injective module-complex presentation with specified derived right adjoints.

DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES_distinguished in Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.DerivedCategory.ShortExact. It constructs a triangle from an already supplied short exact complex; it does not provide the geometric presentation.

Eleven hits for generic triangle and shift tools in Mathlib; none constructs the geometric short exact sequence. Additional project search found schemeKInjective_mayerVietoris_presentation, which assumes a whole-space cover and uses open-scheme categories.

from.place: proper-flat support proof, Mayer--Vietoris globalization of annihilation; scalar naturality of the overlap boundary; direct-image triangle realizing the Mayer-Vietoris boundary before taking Hom; short exact complex before triangle construction
